purpose: Remaining DSPlife Etsy catalog posts awaiting a free Buffer slot. A scheduled task reads this and creates posts as slots open.

queue.text:
Nobody grows on their own. Every success has someone quietly watering it.

That's you. "Support Makes Success," in the shop.

What actually gets a DSP through the morning? We asked around. The answer was unanimous: compassion, and coffee, in that order.

"Compassion + Coffee" is live in the shop.
This work doesn't always get the credit it's due. So we made a sticker that says it out loud: proud to be a Direct Support Professional.

Nobody does this work solo. You've got a crew — the people who cover you, text you back at 11pm, and know exactly what kind of day it's been.

Tag yours.

Showing up the way you do, day after day, takes real strength. Not the flashy kind. The kind nobody claps for.

"DSP Strong" is new in the shop.

Some shifts feel like a storm that won't quit. You're the calm in the middle of it, every time.

New sticker for the people who hold that line.

Two words don't always feel like enough. We're saying them anyway.

Thank you, DSPs. You make a difference — new sticker in the shop.

Every single shift adds up to something, whether or not anyone says so out loud.

We're saying so. "Making a Difference Daily" is in the shop.

Pumpkin spice season has a job description too, apparently.

Fueled by coffee and compassion — the fall version is here.

Compassion sounds nice on a poster. You put it into action, every single shift.

That's the actual difference. New sticker in the shop.

Direct Support Professional isn't just a job title — it's the whole badge. Now available in two colorways: teal or warm.

Same pride either way. Which one's you?

Closing out this run the simple way.

We love our DSPs. That's the whole caption.
